name: Clean my room, Baka!!
source:
James got caught sniffing Holly's clothes and now he has to clean her room! But he's so good! What are we to do, Holly has to share James' talent to all her friends! Well, he'll have to clean ALL of their room too!!

[From [url=https://hypercandychan.itch.io/clean-my-room-baka]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
詹姆斯偷闻霍莉衣服时被抓了个现行，现在不得不罚打扫她的房间将功补过！可他打扫家务的手艺实在是太棒了！这可怎么办才好呢——霍莉当然得把詹姆斯的这项绝活分享给自己的所有闺蜜啦！没办法，这下他只好把她们所有人的房间全都打扫一遍啰！！

[摘自[url=https://hypercandychan.itch.io/clean-my-room-baka]itch.io[/url]]
